items.title: Ralph Sutton interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, September 22, 1995
items.q: And I’ll never forget the night I went with Jack in a taxicab over to the Town Hall where they did the, it was a Louis Armstrong concert... and Sid Catlett, and Peanuts was on that too.

ctx.x: Oh, yeah. All the clubs, two sides of the street you know, on that side and this side. Gee, Art Tatum was playing there, and I’m trying to think. Well this was about the time too © Fillius Jazz Archive -5-

when Jack got together with Louis Armstrong and they had the Louis Armstrong All- Stars. And I’ll never forget the night I went with Jack in a taxicab over to the Town Hall where they did the, it was a Louis Armstrong concert, well he had Bobby Hackett and I think Bob Haggart played on that. And Dick Cary was playing piano, and Sid Catlett, and Peanuts was on that too. That was recorded for RCA Victor. But I’ll never forget, I was sitting up in the balcony looking right down at all the guys you know. And I’m…
